summary: Iteration 5 testing of CHUTEX rebrand and new features. Backend APIs 100% passing (15/15 tests). Frontend has a CRITICAL bug with Profile tab causing infinite loop 'Maximum update depth exceeded' error, making logout impossible.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Clicking Profile tab causes 'Maximum update depth exceeded' React error - infinite loop in expo-router redirect logic
ui_bugs.error_message: Maximum update depth exceeded. This can happen when a component repeatedly calls setState inside componentWillUpdate or componentDidUpdate.
ui_bugs.root_cause: Auth redirect logic exists in BOTH _layout.tsx (root) AND (tabs)/_layout.tsx causing race condition when logout is triggered
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Remove <Redirect href="/" /> from (tabs)/_layout.tsx line 12. Keep auth redirect only in root _layout.tsx

integration_issues.issue: Cannot test logout because Profile tab throws infinite loop error

action_items: CRITICAL FIX: Remove duplicate auth redirect from (tabs)/_layout.tsx to fix Profile tab infinite loop
Test logout functionality after fixing Profile tab
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate Redirect logic: Both /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx have auth redirect logic. The (tabs)/_layout.tsx line 12 has <Redirect href="/" /> which conflicts with root layout's redirect, causing infinite loop on logout.
Fix: Remove line 12 from (tabs)/_layout.tsx: 'if (!user) return <Redirect href="/" />;'

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Profile tab causes 'Maximum update depth exceeded' error
reproduction_steps: 2. Click on 'Profil' tab in bottom navigation
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Race condition between two Redirect components: Root _layout.tsx renders based on user state, while (tabs)/_layout.tsx also has redundant redirect. When user logs out, both try to redirect simultaneously creating infinite loop.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Remove line 12 from /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx: 'if (!user) return <Redirect href="/" />;' - The root layout already handles this case.
